text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"article-based claims with paragraph references","quality":"textual support","description":"It grounds its argument in details from the source article instead of relying mostly on broad generalizations."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs each centered on a different reason","quality":"organizational control","description":"It develops the position in a clearer, more structured progression of reasons."},{"evidence":"explains fuel savings, safety measures, and lower cost of technology","quality":"development of reasons","description":"It expands each claim with supporting explanation rather than stating the point and moving on."},{"evidence":"directly ties driverless cars to saving money and making travel more affordable","quality":"argument elaboration","description":"It shows more cause-and-effect reasoning about why the evidence matters for the position."},{"evidence":"opening introduces technology and then narrows to driverless cars","quality":"focused introduction","description":"It sets up the topic and thesis more smoothly before moving into the argument."}]}
